journey.name: Allowances Turned Off
journey.description: Allowances can be turned off from Dev Settings. With them off the Subscriptions screen shows only the Overview and Payments tabs, and a request covered by an Active allowance is not paid automatically: it opens as an ordinary Payment Request. Turning them back on shows the tab again.

actions.action: Launch the E2E Bitkit app on both instances with an Active allowance, per set-and-accept.xml
On the payer instance, turn dev mode on by tapping the app version in Settings, Support five times, open Dev Settings and turn "Enable Allowances" off (identifier "AllowancesToggle")
Open the drawer menu, tap Subscriptions and verify only the Overview and Payments tabs show, with no Allowances tab (identifier "Tab-allowances")
On the payee instance, send the payer a one-time Payment Request for $2 with the note "AllowancesOff"

On the payer instance, verify it is not paid: no "Payment Executed" notification, and the request opens as an ordinary Payment Request sheet, also listed under the bell (identifier "PaymentRequestsBell")
Turn "Enable Allowances" back on in Dev Settings, open Subscriptions and verify the Allowances tab shows the payee's Active row
